variants.step: cohort_tokens = 1 (one decode step per new wave)
variants.lifetime: cohort_tokens = 154 (median output tokens of the pooled seed-100 traces of both topologies, from experiments/v3_cycle_pricing/runs/dev/*/v3_seed100.json)

parity: cohort_tokens = 0 must reproduce frozen V3 on both topologies (seed 100, 60 s): throughput, P95 TTFT/TPOT, completion, route_counts, query_samples identical

selection.data: seed 100, 300 s, both topologies; control is experiments/v3_cycle_pricing/runs/dev/<case>/v3_seed100.json (same trace)
selection.eligible: relative throughput change vs frozen V3 >= -0.5% on both topologies
selection.score: worst of the two topologies' relative P95 TPOT change vs frozen V3 (lower is better)
selection.pick: eligible variant with the lowest score; if none is eligible or the best score is >= 0, stop and report without formal windows
